terms.name: note
terms.definition: A piece of text with an id.

rules.response: shall return every note in creation order

rules.trigger: the user creates a note with non-empty text
rules.response: shall return the note with the next id, the first being 1

rules.trigger: the text of a new note is empty
rules.response: shall refuse to create the note

contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: notes, version: '1'}
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      x-rules: [R-2, R-3]
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
        '400': {description: empty text}

questions.text: Is text of only spaces empty?
Which status for an empty text?
